summary: Planned the outright retirement of the errors.json/errors-append.sh//errors triage surface. The retention question was settled against the actual implementations: issues.jsonl plus orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh already provide cross-task grouping, recurrence tally, a richer severity/class vocabulary, and three-channel promotion, and central-errors.jsonl provides cross-repo durability errors.json never had. The two things /errors uniquely offers -- a mutable fix_status lifecycle and autonomous fix-task creation -- are respectively never-exercised and deliberately not provided elsewhere by design. The plan is 8 phases across 4 waves, ~10 hours, covering five file deletions plus four live code paths the task description does not enumerate.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan retiring the errors.json triage surface: record audit and discard, file deletion and deregistration, gate-1 narrowing, runtime-allowlist removal, three prose sweeps, and a wipe redeploy with the full gate set.
